question:
**Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word.**

Reluctant
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 3'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given word **"Reluctant" **refers to being unwilling or hesitant.(अनिच्छुक, हिचकिचाहट).
 
• The correct opposite word** "Inclined**" means having a tendency or desire to do something; willing.(उत्सुक, इच्छुक).

Therefore, the **correct answer** is- **'Inclined'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1: **"Loathe" **means to feel intense dislike or disgust for something.(घृणा करना).
 
• Option 2**: "Cagey" **means reluctant to give information owing to caution or suspicion.(सतर्क, संदेहपूर्ण).
 
• Option 4:** "Abatis" **refers to a barricade or defense made of felled trees.(वृक्षों से बनी बाधा).

34:Ta38,
The correct answer is** 'Option 4'**</s
